verdict: three explicit registration adapters are sufficient to schedule the real entry members, but state joins remain required before renderMiniApp

adapters.identity_requirement: enqueue only the concrete f argument; Diana uses Lcom/mgtv/diana/h0/c$a;, whose a field retains the exact c$d request and whose request.h retains the original DianaView$c
enqueue only the posted ny.a/ny.b object; its captured callback must alias c$d.h, ultimately the same DianaView$c
argument 1 is this: the same DianaView that receives DianaView$c.onSuccess and owns mConnected, mIpcBridgeService, packageReady, and mPageContainer

required_state_aliases: DianaView$c.this$0 == bindService ServiceConnection argument == onServiceConnected receiver
bindService return writes the same receiver.mConnected
package loader callback and ServiceConnection callback must join on the same receiver.packageReady/mIpcBridgeService pair
limits: Callback construction alone is not registration.
A false bindService return does not justify onServiceConnected dispatch.
The adapters establish possible asynchronous entry, not callback order or successful network/service completion.
renderMiniApp requires the independently registered package-load callback and service callback state join.
